# Icons

<!-- GENERATED by `scripts/gen-consumer-skills.mjs` — do not edit. Regenerate: `npm run consumer:gen` -->

250 icons in 9 categories, all from `<pkg>/icons`.
Do not install an icon package for something this list already has.

```tsx
import { HomeIcon, CaretDownIcon } from '<pkg>/icons';

<HomeIcon />                       {/* 24px, outline */}
<HomeIcon variant="solid" />
<HomeIcon size={16} />
<HomeIcon className="text-muted-foreground" />   {/* colour follows currentColor */}
```

Inside a Button the icon needs no sizing — the button sizes its own children.

**23 of the 250 are drawn once**, so `variant` changes nothing for them:
`ArrowDownIcon`, `ArrowLeftIcon`, `ArrowRightIcon`, `ArrowUpIcon`, `AtSignIcon`, `AttachIcon`, `BluetoothIcon`, `CaretDownIcon`, `CaretLeftIcon`, `CaretRightIcon`, `CaretUpIcon`, `CheckIcon`, `ExchangeIcon`, `HistoryIcon`, `HotspotIcon`, `MenuIcon`, `MoveIcon`, `Other1Icon`, `Other2Icon`, `RefreshIcon`, `SearchIcon`, `SortIcon`, `ShuffleIcon`.
